budgetNote: Every exception must be inevitable, concrete, and reviewed. CI fails on new ignores not listed here, and on stale allowlist entries.

exceptions.reason: runtime alpha wash from brand.accentRgb channels
exceptions.whyInevitable: Callout tint alpha is computed from brand.accentRgb channels at runtime. A static color.* wash cannot express arbitrary alpha.

exceptions.reason: runtime alpha wash from parsed hex channels
exceptions.whyInevitable: Channels come from Number.parseInt on a runtime hex; the rgba() string is assembled, not a fixed design literal.
